libs.note: BH-8894: owner_mail sends one email to the project owner through the Resend seam, deduped on a key in state/owner-mail.json. The caller (bin/vercel-deploy-snapshot.sh) resolves the rows per project with `lib_env_apply owner-mail <project>` in a subshell, so lib.owner-mail.<project>.<env> wins over lib.owner-mail.<env>.
